title: Fairy Ring + Root Disease, Front 9 Greens
sheet_name: 5800 600L/Ha - Fairy Ring + Root Disease to Greens
last_load: Fert + PGR to Approaches & Surrounds, Fri 16 Oct
site_check: Spray signs out on the front nine greens
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind 3–20 km/h · gusts under 30 · no rain for 48 h
extra_checks: No GPS on the 5800: box out each green, then fill in
Surrounds don't need spraying. Every part of the green does
Watering in lined up behind the sprayer
6–10 mm on each green, starting within 1 h

products.note: Goes in 3rd, before the Zeemil and the wetting agent (sheet had it last).

ppe_note: Terreplex and Zeemil irritate eyes and skin, and Zeemil gives off solvent vapour, so mix in the full kit.
spray_rules: No GPS on this sprayer: box out each green (a lap round the edge), then fill in. Surrounds don't need it, but every part of the green does
Start once Delta T is over 2 (about 8am). Off by 10:30, before the gusts
Water in 6–10 mm behind each green, starting within 1 h. Don't let it dry on the leaf
Keep people off until it's watered in
spray_more: Evolution Advance label: wind 3–20 km/h, medium droplets or coarser, no spraying in an inversion, don't apply if rain is expected within 48 h. Zeemil label: beware of solvent vapours near the open tank.
post_checks: Every green watered in, 6–10 mm, within 1 h of spraying
Soil pass: it must not dry on the leaf

flags.t: Zeemil 2.0 L/ha: at its label max, off-label on turf
flags.d: Zeemil 250 EC (metalaxyl 250 g/L) is registered for pineapples only, at 2 L/ha every 4 to 8 weeks. On greens it's off-label; Victoria allows that at or below the label rate and interval. Last went on greens 18 Sep (31 days). It's the only Pythium root rot product in this tank.
flags.s: APVMA 49822 eLabel · Turf Data reference notes 18 Oct

flags.t: Boom setup checks out: about 600 L/ha
flags.d: Toro's Multi Pro nozzles use Toro's own colour code, not the ISO one: Blue is the 1.0 gpm size (AIC part 120-0705). At 3 bar that's 3.95 L/min a nozzle; on 50 cm spacing at 7.8 km/h it's about 608 L/ha (Toro's chart: 593 L/ha at 8 km/h, 677 at 7). Keep the speed steady at 7.8.
flags.s: Toro Multi Pro Spray Nozzle Selection Guide (metric, 50 cm spacing)

flags.t: Evolution Advance 2.2 L/ha is the label high rate
flags.d: Fairy ring 1.6–2.2 L/ha. Label: low rate from late October to early November, high rate if symptoms are present, reapply after 30 days if needed. Max 2 consecutive sprays, 3 per season.

flags.t: Rain inside the 48 h label restraint
flags.d: Evolution Advance: don't apply if rain is expected within 48 h. The forecast has about 1 to 2.5 mm on Tue 20 Oct. Light, and the tank is watered in anyway, but it's a label condition.

flags.t: Wash in straight away: 600 L/ha is under label volume
flags.d: The label's root-disease use is about 1000 L/ha with 6–10 mm of irrigation within 1 hour. At 600 L/ha the washing in matters more: start on each green as soon as it's sprayed.

flags.t: Fungicide + wetting agent on bentgrass in the heat
flags.d: Tebuconazole plus HydroForce, 27 °C by afternoon, five days after Shadow Ultra and Promote Plus. Envu's guidance is to keep wetting agents two weeks clear of DMI fungicides. Spraying early and watering in straight behind keeps it off the leaf.

flags.t: No leaf cover from this pass
flags.d: Evolution Advance's dollar spot, brown patch and anthracnose claims are leaf and crown uses (350–500 L/ha, left on the leaf). Watered in, this is a root-zone pass, so don't count it against the 22–24 Oct leaf-disease spike.
Evolution Advance moves from last to 3rd so the suspension goes in before the EC (Zeemil) and the wetting agent. HydroForce goes in last. Companion and Terreplex condition the water first.
